alexander-volkanovski-movsar-evloev.summary: Evloev won the first round on all three Sherdog cards with three takedowns, though Volkanovski stood up from each almost at once and kept landing low kicks and right hands. In round 2 Volkanovski reversed a takedown into top position, then rocked Evloev with a left hook and a combination; Evloev turned away to his back and Volkanovski poured on right hands until Goddard stopped it at 4:54, Evloev's first loss in 21 fights. Volkanovski said afterwards he had fought sick.
alexander-volkanovski-movsar-evloev.turning_point: Round 2: Volkanovski switched off Evloev's takedown and ended up on top; from then Evloev stopped wrestling and was hurt standing.

checks.note: Getting up and out-working Evloev held; the 'neither finishes' half failed, Volkanovski stopped him in round 2.

petr-yan-merab-dvalishvili.summary: Dvalishvili took the first two rounds on every Sherdog card, ducking into takedown after takedown and forcing Yan to spend energy getting up. From round 3 Yan stopped the shots almost entirely, hurt Dvalishvili with body kicks and combinations and swept the last three rounds as the challenger tired: 48-47 on all three official cards. Dvalishvili was credited with a UFC-record 58 takedown attempts, only five of them successful.
petr-yan-merab-dvalishvili.turning_point: Round 3: Yan's crushing body kick and his takedown defence turned the fight; Dvalishvili was spent by round 5.

checks.claim: Yan's takedown defence beat Dvalishvili's chain wrestling in the rematch and Yan lands the heavier shots: decision
checks.note: Five takedowns from 58 attempts, and none in the last three rounds; Yan's shots were the heavier ones. Decision, as picked.

lone-er-kavanagh-ramazonbek-temirov.summary: Temirov came out throwing a spinning back kick and big overhand rights, but swung and missed often while Kavanagh stuck to his jab, hit the body and slipped the return fire. By the late minutes Temirov's right eye was swelling shut; Kavanagh dazed him with a left uppercut, dropped him and finished with lefts on the floor at 4:28 of round 1.

alexander-volkov-rizvan-kuniev.summary: Volkov started slowly, then took over with his jab, body kicks and calf kicks, and won the clinch exchanges as well; Kuniev's best moments were a Superman punch in round 2 and a burst at the start of round 3. Volkov's kicks had Kuniev hobbling and switching stances, and late in round 3 he sprawled on a takedown, took the back and hunted a choke to the bell: a unanimous decision (29-28, 30-27, 30-27), 30-27 on every Sherdog card.

Keita stood and landed a left, but Pico answered with a one-two and dropped him with a right cross, finishing with punches on the floor at 1:14 of round 1: the first real stoppage loss of Keita's career.

grant-dawson-nurullo-aliev.summary: Aliev started fast, pressing Dawson to the fence, dropping him with a straight left and landing on top, but he lost a point for hammerfists to the back of the head. Dawson took him down late in round 1 and nearly caught a guillotine, then out-wrestled a tiring Aliev for two rounds, five takedowns in all, finishing in full mount with elbows: 29-27 on every official and Sherdog card.

The unbeaten debutant Chopurov pressed and took round 1 while escaping two Thicknesse guillotines, Thicknesse won round 2 with elbows, knees and combinations, and Chopurov took him down repeatedly in round 3 but kept letting him back up. Sherdog's three scorers all had Chopurov 29-28; two judges gave it to Thicknesse, a split decision.
